mapper.sql: SELECT k.keyword_id, k.keyword, k.synonym_words, k.exclude_words, k.match_type, k.region_code, k.industry, k.min_amount, k.notice_types, k.notify_enabled, k.enabled, k.del_flag, k.create_by, k.create_time, k.update_by, k.update_time, k.remark FROM bid_crawl_keyword k
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO bid_crawl_keyword (keyword, synonym_words, exclude_words, match_type, region_code, industry, min_amount, notice_types, notify_enabled, enabled, del_flag, create_by, create_time, remark) VALUES (#{keyword}, #{synonymWords}, #{excludeWords}, #{matchType}, #{regionCode}, #{industry}, #{minAmount}, #{noticeTypes}, #{notifyEnabled}, #{enabled}, '0', #{createBy}, sysdate(), #{remark})
mapper.delete: UPDATE bid_crawl_keyword SET del_flag = '2' WHERE keyword_id IN #{keywordId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO bid_keyword_scope (keyword_id, scope_type, dept_id, user_id) VALUES (#{keywordId}, #{scopeType}, #{deptId}, #{userId})
